conviction_note: Q1 OP was already 68% of the unchanged H1 plan and the public June-August 月次 put Q2 sales about 7% above what the plan implies, so the H1 beat is visible and only lightly sized. What the release adds is the full-year decision: holding the plan would imply H2 OP down roughly 40% on easy comps, while IFIS consensus (ordinary 21.8bn, unchanged for 4 weeks) sits only 4% above the plan. A raise is more likely than not, which gives a positive lean. p_up is held at 57 because this name was sold after 3 of its last 4 prints, DCM was sold on a hold-the-plan H1 two weeks ago, and margin longs are 5.45x shorts. The finding sum (+1.0) is twice the scaled number (+0.49) because the sum carries the full-year raise at its probability-weighted size, while p_up also holds the sell-the-print history.

findings.finding: The H1 beat against the company plan is close to locked: Q1 OP 10,151 was 67.9% of the H1 OP plan (14,950), against a Q1 share of about 47% in prior years. The plan implies Q2 OP of only 4,798 on Q2 operating revenue of 130,880, down about 2.5% YoY. The 月次 show all-store sales of -1.5% in June, +8.5% in July and +6.9% in August, about +4.6% for the quarter, which puts H1 OP around 17-18bn, roughly 15-22% over plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026-07-10 (15:30): OP +42.8% with the H1 plan held, stock +4.16% the next session. H1 2025-10-09: H1 ordinary missed the company plan by 12% and the FY plan was held, stock -2.4% the next session (https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/7516_20251009_act_20251009_153016_9).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Q1 progress and the 月次 are public, and the stock is about 8% above its pre-Q1 level (4,085 to 4,410). What is left is the size of Q2 margin, which the 月次 do not show. If the market had fully priced H1 at ~17.6bn OP, IFIS would not still carry FY ordinary at 21.8bn, below what H1 plus last year's H2 implies.
findings.independence: Q1 deck forecast table (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260710590969.pdf, p.20) for the implied Q2 plan; July 月次 (https://www.ryutsuu.biz/sales/s081872.html). All are company disclosures, so this is one underlying source.

findings.finding: The full-year plan (OP 23,000 / ordinary 21,000) looks unholdable after this H1. With H1 OP at ~17.6bn, holding it implies H2 OP of about 5.4bn, against 7.7bn last year (3,799 + 3,896), a weak base. September all-store sales were already +5.7% (existing +1.9%). IFIS ordinary consensus is 21,800, only 3.8% above plan and unchanged for 4 weeks. A raise to roughly 24-25bn ordinary at this release would be 10-15% above the sourced street number. A hold would repeat DCM's sold reaction.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-09: FY held at H1, -2.4%. 2026-01-09: FY cut (ordinary 24,000 to 19,800), -2.75%. 2026-04-13: new-year guide of OP +2.7%, -3.67%. October 2020: raised H1 and FY together after a beat (s.kabutan.jp k202010090041). Peer DCM held FY at H1 on 2026-09-29 despite beating H1, and fell sharply over the next sessions (kabutan n202609300406).
findings.why_not_priced: The stock trades at about 10x the unrevised company EPS (443 yen), and the one sourced street number (IFIS 21.8bn ordinary, target 5,350) has not moved since before the Q2 月次 completed. If a raise were in the price, the consensus would sit near 24bn, or the stock would have rallied on the September 月次 instead of falling 5.6% with DCM. The risk is management conservatism: the H1 plan was held at Q1 despite 68% progress.
findings.independence: Separate document: the Q1 deck forecast table (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260710590969.pdf) gives the plan and the H2 it implies. September 月次 (https://www.ryutsuu.biz/sales/s100776.html). kabutan finance page for last year's H2 quarters (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=7516).

findings.finding: Peer read-through: DCM HD (reported 2026-09-29) saw Jun-Aug OP fall 12.4% on sales up 7.1%, with existing-store sales -4.3% and the OP margin falling from 7.9% to 6.4% on weather. It held its FY plan and fell for several sessions. Kohnan's own Q2 existing-store sales were about +0.9%, but Q2 gross margin is unknown, and the Q1 margin gain came from 'special demand' that let it hold back markdowns.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Kohnan fell 2.3% on 9/29, then 1.35%, 0.34% and 1.71% over the days DCM traded off its print. That looks like the read-through being taken already.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: Kohnan already fell with DCM. What is left is Kohnan's own Q2 gross margin (Q1 deck: the Q1 margin gain came from markdown restraint under special demand, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260710590969.pdf p.6), which no public series shows.
findings.independence: DCM Q2 short article (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3050&b=k202609290012) is the same event. Kohnan's own 月次 point the other way on sales.

Returns: dividend plan 140 (70 interim), a 連続増配 company, so a dividend raise is possible if the FY is raised; no buyback is running. New-year guide: n/a (H1 print). Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q1 was 67.9% of the H1 plan against about 47% in prior years. H1 will land about 15-22% over plan, which is visible from the 月次.
baseline_tension: The finding sum leans positive while the baseline lean is -0.40 (crowded margin long) and the run-up is flat over 20 days but +2.4% over 5 and +1.85% intraday. The strongest positive the release could carry is a FY raise plus a dividend increase; I looked for a buyback and found none running. The strongest negative is a hold-the-plan H1 like DCM's, which this name has also done before. Its record of selling prints (3 of 4) keeps p_up near 57.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a series the market already has): the H1-beat finding rests on public 月次 and Q1 progress, so it was trimmed from +0.3 to +0.2. The DCM read-through is a public peer print the stock already traded on, so it was trimmed from -0.3 to -0.2. p_up was not changed, because the lean rests on the FY decision the release adds, not on the visible quarter.
Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): not triggered, since the set leans positive. The strongest positive and negative the release could carry are written in baseline_tension.
Open question 4 (five-day run-in): +2.4% over 5 days plus +1.85% intraday. Not sized as a negative; one case is not a rule.
Net: the sum is unchanged at +1.0 and expected_move unchanged at +0.49.
